run_awq_quantization_ddp: run AWQ quantization on a Qwen3 MoE model using distributed data parallel with torchrun
create_awq_quantization_recipe: create an AWQ quantization recipe with W4A16 scheme and ignore specific MoE layers
load_offloaded_model_ddp: load an offloaded LLM model initialized for distributed data parallel training
test_quantized_model_generation: test a quantized model by generating text from a prompt to verify correctness
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
